_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with hundreds of brands that are respected household names throughout the world'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In U.S. measured channels, our chief beverage competitor, The Coca-Cola Company, has a larger share of carbonated soft drinks (CSD) consumption, while we have a larger share of liquid refreshment beverages consumption', and 'In addition, The Coca-Cola Company has a significant CSD share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2011 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with hundreds of brands that are respected household names throughout the world'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In U.S. measured channels, our chief beverage competitor, The Coca-Cola Company, has a larger share of carbonated soft drinks (CSD) consumption, while we have a larger share of liquid refreshment beverages consumption', and 'In addition, The Coca-Cola Company has a significant CSD share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2011 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.38x; -3% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.20; conservative 2yr +15%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.0%/yr (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +1.2%/yr (Q3 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.2%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +17.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2012-11-23) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.38x (18.8% downside to Bear $57 / +49.6% upside to Bull $105) | Adj composite 2.63 vs market 2.43: gap +0.20 [FAIRLY VALUED] | -3% above the EPP floor $73 (18x FY12E $4.03) | Conservative 2-yr case: +15.4% total (+7.7%/yr) | At 17.4x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $93 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; servings +4.0% in Q3 2012, forward revenues +0% (Q3 2012 net revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
